summary: Registering an OAuth app on X requires a developer account, which may need approval. Once approved, you create a project and app in the developer portal, providing details like redirect URIs and privacy policy.
requirements: X developer account (may require application and review)

steps.text: Apply for an X developer account at developer.x.com
Wait for developer account approval (if required)
Create a new project in the X Developer Portal
Create an app within the project, providing app name, description, website, redirect URIs, terms of service, privacy policy
Configure OAuth 2.0 settings (enable OAuth 2.0, set callback URIs)
Save and note the Client ID and Client Secret

blockers: Developer account approval can take time and may be rejected if use case doesn't comply with policies
Essential access has strict rate limits; Elevated access requires additional review
Redirect URIs must use HTTPS and match exactly
Apps must comply with X's Developer Agreement and Policy
Changes to app settings may require re-review
